import bpy,bmesh,math,json,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['bank15'];root=ns['root'];cap=ns['cap'];craft=ns['craft'];archive=ns['archive'];linear=ns['linear']
assert craft.get('bank15_masonry') and not craft.get('bank15_shore')
def sm(a,b,x):
 t=min(1.,max(0.,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3.-2.*t)
def worldxy(x,y):return 11.5+.5*x+math.sqrt(3)/2*y,34+math.sqrt(3)/2*x-.5*y
def shore(z):return 8+math.sin(z*.14)*2+math.sin(z*.37+.4)*.6+2.2*math.exp(-((z+2.5)/3.6)**2)-.85*math.exp(-((z-2.5)/(3.6*.65))**2)
def baseheight(x,y):
 wx,wz=worldxy(x,y);off=wx-shore(wz)
 if off<0:
  d=-off;return -.11*d-.013*d*d/(1+d*.025)
 return min(off*.2,.7)+sm(2,14,off)*(.2+math.sin(wz*.21)*.16)
def bank_sample(x,y,old):
 base=baseheight(x,y);wx,wz=worldxy(x,y);off=wx-shore(wz)
 back=(1-sm(4.6,7.9,abs(x)))*sm(1.4,3.1,y)*(1-sm(9.3,12.6,y))
 # The visible shoulder fans back inland rather than ending as a square turf pad.
 toe=-4.50+.23*max(0,x-4.48)**2+.16*math.sin((x-4.48)*1.7)
 side=sm(4.04,4.44,x)*(1-sm(4.70,9.05,x))*sm(toe-.15,toe+1.40,y)*(1-sm(8.2,11.8,y))
 land=sm(.4,2.1,off)
 crest=1.49+.035*math.sin(y*.62)-.018*math.cos(x*.8+y*.6)
 h=base+max(0,1.35-base)*back*land
 h=max(h,base+max(0,crest-base)*side*land)
 cx=6.48+.20*max(y+.4,0)+.25*math.sin(max(y+.4,0)*.47)
 path=(1-sm(.90,1.55,abs(x-cx)))*sm(-2.25,-1.25,y)*(1-sm(8.8,11.2,y))
 pathh=1.004+.14*sm(1.5,7.5,y)
 h=h*(1-path)+max(base,pathh)*path
 inlet=(1-sm(.98,1.65,abs(y+.41)))*sm(4.12,4.4,x)*(1-sm(6.7,8.0,x))
 h=h*(1-inlet)+max(base,1.004)*inlet
 old_edge=sm(.002,.12,old-base)
 h=old+(h-old)*old_edge
 h-=.014*(1-sm(.003,.05,h-base))*old_edge
 use=sm(.018,.18,h-base)
 # Bare work ground dominates the immediate wall and steps. Scrub occurs only in broken margins.
 local=np.array([160.,149.,118.])/255
 scrub=(1-path)*(1-inlet)*sm(5.10,7.50,x)*sm(-1.4,2.4,y)*(1-sm(8.3,10.5,y))
 patches=sm(.18,.75,.5+.32*math.sin(x*.95+y*.54)+.18*math.cos(y*1.25-x*.2))
 scrub*=patches*.55
 local=local*(1-scrub)+np.array([129.,136.,96.])/255*scrub
 local=local*(1-path*.55)+np.array([167.,151.,116.])/255*path*.55
 local=local*(1-inlet*.45)+np.array([166.,151.,118.])/255*inlet*.45
 tint=np.array([179.,170.,137.])/255*(1-use)+local*use
 return float(h),tuple(linear(tint))
old=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'];new=old.copy();new.data=old.data.copy()
old.name='M14 bank before B15 integration';archive.objects.link(old);craft.objects.unlink(old);craft.objects.link(new);new.name='M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'
me=new.data;cols=[];heights=[]
for v in me.vertices:
 h,col=bank_sample(v.co.x,v.co.y,v.co.z);heights.append((float(v.co.z),h));v.co.z=h;cols.append((*col,1))
ca=me.color_attributes['GroundTint']
for li,loop in enumerate(me.loops):ca.data[li].color=cols[loop.vertex_index]
me.update()
bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(me)
unused=[f for f in bm.faces if all(v.co.z<=baseheight(v.co.x,v.co.y)+.0005 for v in f.verts)]
count=len(unused)
if unused:bmesh.ops.delete(bm,geom=unused,context='FACES')
loose=[v for v in bm.verts if not v.link_faces]
if loose:bmesh.ops.delete(bm,geom=loose,context='VERTS')
bm.to_mesh(me);bm.free();me.update()
for p in me.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
new['bank15_shore']=True;new['bank15_extra_buried_faces_removed']=count
tree=BVHTree.FromPolygons([v.co for v in me.vertices],[list(p.vertices) for p in me.polygons])
def surface(x,y):
 hit=tree.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,8)),Vector((0,0,-1)),15)[0]
 return hit.z if hit else float(baseheight(x,y))
placement=json.loads((root/'captures/shipyard_stone_20261115/plant_placement.json').read_text())
plantmoves=[]
for j,entry in enumerate(placement):
 x,y=entry['xy'];h=surface(x,y)+.003;delta=h-entry['root_height']
 obs=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(j)+' leaf')]
 assert len(obs)==7
 for o in obs:o.location.z+=delta

ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for o in timber for v in o.bound_box]
low=min(v.z for v in ps);highground=max(surface(x,y) for x in [4.44,5.38] for y in [5.8,8.2])
delta=highground+.035-low
for o in timber:o.location.z+=delta

(cap/'shore_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps({'samples':samples,'old_vertices':len(heights),'new_vertices':len(me.vertices),'new_faces':len(me.polygons),'extra_unused_faces_removed':count,'max_raise':max(b-a for a,b in heights),'max_lower':min(b-a for a,b in heights),'plant_moves':plantmoves,'timber_objects':len(timber),'timber_delta':delta},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
ns['baseheight']=baseheight;ns['surface']=surface;ns['bank']=new
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
